patches.summary: Add opt-in OS keychain token storage for auth set-token --stdin --keychain.
patches.reason: The preview needs a secure-store path that keeps token values out of config files while preserving env override behavior and keeping broad public launch approval explicit.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/config ./internal/cli -run 'Test(Auth.*Keychain|AuthStatusReportsKeychain|Load.*Keychain|SetupCheck.*Keychain|CredentialsPlanNamed)' covers keychain save, status, logout, setup check classification, env override, missing keychain behavior, and credentials plan wording.

patches.summary: Add safe stdin token setup, env-token persistence protection, and stdin-first guidance for auth set-token.
patches.reason: The generated argv-only token setup can expose tokens through shell history and process lists. The preview needs a safer config-file path while preserving legacy argv compatibility, and stdin saves must not persist an env token imported during config load.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli covers stdin save, env-token non-persistence, empty stdin rejection, and stdin-first help/status guidance.

patches.summary: Adapt provenance-backed generated read output from results/meta to the target agent envelope.
patches.reason: Generated read commands route JSON output through wrapWithProvenance. Updating that helper reduces the agent JSON launch blocker without mass-editing generated command files.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli covers valid JSON payloads under data, non-JSON payloads as strings under data, empty warnings, null pagination, null trace_id, null error, and removal of results/meta.

patches.summary: Wrap printJSONFiltered local typed output in the target envelope only when --agent is active.
patches.reason: Normal --json output for command-specific local helpers should stay raw for compatibility, while --agent needs the same target envelope as other covered agent paths.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestPrintJSONFiltered|TestWhichAgentUsesLocalAgentEnvelope' covers raw normal JSON, agent envelope output, select inside data, and which --agent.

patches.summary: Suppress generated endpoint dry-run request previews when --agent is active.
patches.reason: Generated endpoint dry-runs return a JSON result that the CLI wraps in the target agent envelope. Human request preview text must not appear around that machine-readable agent output, while non-agent dry-run previews remain available.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestPrintProvenance(SuppressesAgentModeWhenTerminal|KeepsNonAgentTerminalOutput)|TestCustomersListDryRun(AgentSuppressesHumanPreview|WithoutAgentKeepsHumanPreview)' covers quiet agent dry-run output, suppressed agent provenance under terminal conditions, and preserved non-agent previews/provenance.

patches.summary: Make agent-context --agent emit the target agent envelope while preserving the raw v3 agent-context schema for normal JSON output.
patches.reason: The generated agent-context command is a command-specific raw JSON path. Agents using --agent should receive the same target envelope shape as other covered command paths, with the existing agent context object under data.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli -run 'TestAgentContextAgentUsesTargetEnvelope|TestWrapWithProvenance' and go test ./internal/cli passed; focused coverage proves schema_version 1.0, agent context under data, and no top-level results/meta.

patches.summary: Add a local-only about command with Straddle ASCII presentation and structured machine output.
patches.reason: Ramp-parity presentation polish needs a small, useful local command that explains preview status without credentials, API calls, or production writes.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli covers human output, JSON output, agent envelope output, and credential-free local execution.

patches.summary: Replace token-bearing auth guidance in doctor, CLI API errors, and MCP API errors with stdin-first or secret-manager guidance.
patches.reason: Generated auth hints should not recommend commands that put API tokens in shell history or process arguments.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli ./internal/mcp covers doctor, classifyAPIError, and MCP auth error guidance without token-bearing commands.

patches.summary: Expose endpoint, typed, and runtime MCP tool counts separately in the context tool.
patches.reason: The generated context tool reported the 70 endpoint metadata count as tool_count, which was stale for agents because runtime tools/list exposes 83 tools after typed framework tools and Cobra shell-out tools are registered.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp covers handleContext JSON count fields and runtime shell-out tool names.

patches.summary: Wrap sync --agent and real tail --agent stream lines in the target agent envelope.
patches.reason: Sync and tail are NDJSON streams with separate output paths from generated read commands. Agents need each stream line to use the target envelope while normal --json streams stay raw for compatibility.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'Test.*(Sync|Tail).*Agent|Test.*Stream|Test.*Redact' covers sync agent envelopes, warning events, tail data envelopes, final tail_end, sensitive key redaction, and raw non-agent tail JSON streams.

patches.summary: Add docs search as a first-class terminal flow separate from synced local data search.
patches.reason: Product docs, API reference docs, SDK docs, generated command capabilities, and synced local data are different sources. The generated search command already means local synced data search, so docs lookup needs its own command tree.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'Test.*Docs' covers product docs MCP search with httptest, loopback-only endpoint overrides, bounded responses and parsed fields, commands source JSON, API guidance JSON, dry-run metadata without a server call, docs search --agent target envelope output, and docs search rejecting --deliver before webhook delivery. go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp ./internal/mcp/cobratree covers docs_search MCP shell-out exposure, docs_search readOnlyHint, and top-level search staying typed-only.

patches.summary: Add a help-only sandbox guide command for sandbox testing scenarios.
patches.reason: The Claude-only /sandbox-test walkthrough listed useful sandbox scenarios but encouraged live execution. The CLI needs a first-class local guidance path that preserves the scenario list without calling APIs, docs endpoints, or production.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'Test.*Sandbox|Test.*Docs' covers scenario list policy, ACH return guidance, invalid scenarios, --agent envelope output, and --deliver rejection before webhook delivery. go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp ./internal/mcp/cobratree covers sandbox_guide MCP shell-out exposure and readOnlyHint.

patches.summary: Add a local-only setup check command for first-run readiness.
patches.reason: First-run setup needs a visible preflight that summarizes local config, environment classification, auth source, profiles, MCP sibling presence, docs search readiness, and sandbox guide readiness without calling APIs, docs endpoints, MCP, webhooks, or production.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'Test.*Setup|Test.*Sandbox|Test.*Docs' covers local-only JSON, sandbox and production classification, agent envelope output, and deliver rejection. go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp ./internal/mcp/cobratree covers setup_check MCP shell-out exposure, readOnlyHint, and destructiveHint false.

patches.summary: Add local-only operational workflow guidance for reconciliation, fraud monitoring, collections, reporting, and monitoring.
patches.reason: Operators and agents need a safe planning command that points to current-docs lookup queries and read-side CLI surfaces without making API calls, docs calls, MCP calls, webhook posts, production writes, live reports, polling, or alerting.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'Test.*Ops' covers the five-workflow list, named workflow coverage including reporting and monitoring, invalid workflow, agent envelope output, and deliver rejection. jq empty packages/cli/straddle-pp-cli/.printing-press-patches.json validates the patch manifest.

patches.summary: Add local-only live-smoke planning guidance for setup, customers, payments, funding, MCP, and all scopes.
patches.reason: The preview needs a safe runbook generator for a future approved read-only smoke without making live calls, executing MCP tools, touching sandbox or production, or implying approval.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestSmokePlan' covers scope list, named scopes, real command resolution for command suggestions, all scope, invalid scope, agent envelope output, and deliver rejection. go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp -run 'TestHandleContextIncludesMCPCountBreakdown|TestRegisterToolsMarksDocsSearchReadOnly' and go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp/cobratree -run 'TestRegisterAllExposesNestedDocsSearchAndSkipsTopLevelSearch' cover smoke_plan MCP shell-out exposure, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint false, and runtime count 84.

patches.summary: Add a local-only approval scope to smoke plan with structured live-smoke approval packet fields.
patches.reason: The outstanding live-smoke blocker needs the required written approval captured as CLI output before anyone can run a future read-only live smoke.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestSmokePlan' covers approval scope listing, real local proof command resolution, structured approval packet fields, expected evidence, stop criteria, transcript guidance, all-scope expansion to six concrete plans, and token literal leakage checks.

patches.summary: Add an approval-file-gated smoke run surface for setup and customers, including redacted transcript artifact writing.
patches.reason: The preview needs a narrow executable read-only smoke path that cannot run by default, rejects production-looking targets and token literals, writes reviewable redacted evidence, and can be tested with local fake servers before any future approved live read.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestSmokeRun' covers approval-file requirements, production base URL rejection, scope mismatch, token literal rejection, unsupported run scopes, setup with no API call, customers against a local fake server, redacted transcript JSON writing, parent directory creation, 0600 file mode, and failed customers_list transcript evidence before error return.

patches.summary: Add local-only public-release readiness guidance for archives, compatibility, docs/support, Homebrew, MCP, naming, npm, owner decisions, signing, and all surfaces.
patches.reason: The preview needs a safe runbook command that reduces the public-release distribution, current-CLI compatibility, docs, support, and owner-decision blockers without publishing, pushing, uploading, signing, notarizing, calling external services, executing MCP tools, reading secrets, replacing public straddle, approving support, approving workflow execution claims, or approving migration or alias plans.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestReleasePlan' covers surface list, compatibility local proof commands, Stainless reference-only wording, public straddle replacement blockers, docs/support honesty, naming honesty, owner-decision guidance, named surfaces, all surfaces, invalid surface, agent envelope output, and deliver rejection. go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp -run 'TestHandleContextIncludesMCPCountBreakdown|TestRegisterToolsMarksDocsSearchReadOnly' and go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp/cobratree -run 'TestRegisterAllExposesNestedDocsSearchAndSkipsTopLevelSearch' cover release_plan MCP shell-out exposure, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint false, and the current MCP count validation.

patches.summary: Add local-only credential storage readiness guidance for config, environment, MCP, keychain, packaged-client, launch, and all surfaces.
patches.reason: The preview needs a safe runbook command that reduces the auth launch blocker without reading secrets, printing secrets, writing credentials, calling services, executing MCP tools, or approving launch. The packaged-client surface makes required built CLI/MCP binary smoke steps machine-readable as local guidance only.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestCredentialsPlan' covers surface list, packaged-client required local proof commands, named surfaces, all surfaces, invalid surface, agent envelope output, deliver rejection, and no token value leakage. The packaged-client guidance states that it does not build packages, run binaries, read secrets, write credentials, call Straddle APIs, execute MCP tools, publish, sign, notarize, or approve launch. go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp -run 'TestHandleContextIncludesMCPCountBreakdown|TestRegisterToolsMarksDocsSearchReadOnly' and go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp/cobratree -run 'TestRegisterAllExposesNestedDocsSearchAndSkipsTopLevelSearch' cover credentials_plan MCP shell-out exposure, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint false, and the then-current runtime count.

patches.summary: Add local-only structured workflow planning guidance for reconciliation, fraud monitoring, collections, reporting, monitoring, and all workflows.
patches.reason: The preview needs a structured command plan that is more agent-useful than prose-only ops guidance while still making no live calls, reading no credentials, executing no MCP tools, posting no webhooks, touching no sandbox or production environment, writing no data, and approving no live execution.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestWorkflowPlan' covers workflow list, named workflows, all workflows, invalid workflow, agent envelope output, deliver rejection before profile preload, profile rejection before profile-store creation, safety metadata, and token literal leakage checks. go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp -run 'TestHandleContextIncludesMCPCountBreakdown|TestRegisterToolsMarksDocsSearchReadOnly' and go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp/cobratree -run 'TestRegisterAllExposesNestedDocsSearchAndSkipsTopLevelSearch' cover workflow_plan MCP shell-out exposure, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint false, and runtime count 87.

patches.summary: Add local-only MCP client config generation for the generated straddle-pp-mcp stdio sibling.
patches.reason: Desktop MCP packaging remains future work, but local users and agents need machine-readable config fragments for Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, and generic stdio clients without installing, writing files, reading secrets, calling APIs, executing MCP, publishing, signing, or approving launch.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run 'TestMCPConfig' covers available clients, safety metadata, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, stdio, all-client output, blank and token-literal binary rejection, and --deliver rejection. go test -count=1 ./internal/mcp ./internal/mcp/cobratree -run 'TestHandleContextIncludesMCPCountBreakdown|TestRegisterToolsMarksDocsSearchReadOnly|TestRegisterAll' covers runtime count 89, mcp_config shell-out metadata, and readOnlyHint. jq empty .printing-press-patches.json validates the patch manifest.
